# Extra inputs for the JS -> Java parity fixture (scripts/gen-parity.mjs).
#
# One JSON string literal per line, so control characters, zero-width
# characters and lone surrogates can be written as explicit \u escapes.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# These are synthetic edge cases for the PORT. They are not corpus cases and
# say nothing about what should or should not be profanity.
